rationale: The paper reports a small positive association between neuron coverage and steering-angle deviation but explicitly says it does not know that the coverage increase causes the deviation increase and calls for further work to establish whether neuron coverage is a consistent indicator. That supports the narrow claim and directly defeats any attempt to treat activation coverage as a composite safety score.
evidence_locators: S-EVID-007-R1, Toohey, Raunak and Binkley, correlation and threats-to-validity discussion, PDF pp. 7-8
S-EVID-007-R2, Toohey, Raunak and Binkley, conclusion, PDF p. 8
limitations: The study used one DNN, transformed images and a steering-angle-deviation proxy; it did not establish a hazard-failure threshold.
No predictive value across releases, ODD partitions, sensor modalities, or an airborne DAA function has been shown.
